scope: Proposition 2.4 (Quenched scalar Cardy convergence) of the manuscript “From critical crossings to quenched near-critical universality in Voronoi percolation” (preprints/From-critical-crossings-to-quenched-near-critical-universality-in-Voronoi-percolation-October-5-2026/critical-crossings-quenched-near-critical-universality-voronoi-percolation.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 224 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 164f1043f61eb5e7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every fixed polygon quad Q, Pηe (CQ) −→ Cardy(Q) in probability over the Poisson geometry. The assertion holds simultaneously for every member of any fixed finite collection of polygon quads.
